linkedin.activityText: Alexis Ohanian Sr. Alexis Ohanian Sr. 8h Alexis Ohanian Sr. shared this I was very excited to lead this at pre-seed because I want my kids to have a healthy relationship with tech while ALSO spending as much time in the world as possible - and this is the first phone that actually had the goal of keeping kids engaged in the WORLD. Lemme know what you think - we just launched and we're already at thousands of pre-orders Sam Terris Sam Terris 17h Alexis Ohanian Sr. shared this Freckle is the first kids phone built for real-world adventure. It is available for pre-order today, and we will begin shipping in December of this year. I’m still a rookie when it comes to fatherhood. It can feel like an impossible sum of new information to get my arms around and the protocols have become rather data-centric & exacting. I sometimes feel the mild judgement of older generations who are skeptical of our obsession around naps, feeding schedules, etc. But I think for the most part, we’ve made a lot of progress in our understanding of creating systems to help kids best self-actualize. One area where we seem to have moved in the wrong direction, however, is kids’ independence. They are spending remarkably little time exploring, playing, and just being kids outside the supervision of an adult. It’s so hard for a kid to develop in an environment where a parent is hovering over their shoulder. There’s no space to experiment, to expand. At the same time, passive screen consumption has gone way up. A loss of physical freedom was replaced with essentially unfettered digital access. In response, the market has produced a bunch of products oriented around parent anxiety, completely optimized for the job of giving parents more control. Billed as tools for safety, they're generally used as ankle monitors and can make it even harder for kids to develop autonomy. At Freckle, we believe the best product in this space will focus less on restriction, and more on safely empowering kids. We started by asking kids what they want, designed to their sensibilities, and ultimately developed tools to give them more agency, and more space to explore the world beyond the screen. We created a product where parents can meaningfully participate beyond surveillance & control. Right-sizing technology doesn't have to mean stripping it to its studs. Freckle is fun! And it is exactly what I want for my own family. Alexis Ohanian Sr. Alexis Ohanian Sr. 18h Alexis Ohanian Sr. shared this I've learned a lot in my 6 years of team ownership: launching teams is actually more similar to launching tech startups than people realize and the MOST important thing you can get right as an owner is who you hire as President. The success of our rollout so far is a testament to Ana and the team she's built; the future is bright for women's volleyball in LA and we're gonna continue to set a standard not just for global volleyball, but for sports!
